WHAT: memory-ts fork of @rlabs-inc/memory, published as @neolio42/memory v0.7.0

WHERE: https://github.com/Neolio42/memory-ts

HOW: Install with `bun add github:Neolio42/memory-ts` or clone directly. Not published to npm yet (no npm login). Production server runs from local source via launch agent.

CHANGES IN v0.7.0:
- Dedup-aware curation (curator sees existing memories, outputs supersedes)
- Deterministic manager (3 rules, no LLM calls)
- Global scope routing fixed (global memories go to ~/.local/share/memory/global/)
- event_date field added
- supersedes field support
- Model: claude-sonnet-4-6
- Cross-segment dedup
